Class JeanGuy

java.lang.Object
entities.players.Players
entities.players.Playable
entities.players.JeanGuy
public class JeanGuy extends Playable
Class representing the playable character "JeanGuy".

This class handles player-specific properties such as sprites, attacks, defense animations, item collection, and color variations (red version). It extends the Playable class and uses a KeyHandler to respond to player input.

      Handles picking up an item in the game world.

      Supports collecting:

      • BouclierBois if the player has enough money

      • Coeur to restore health
